name: Calendar Notes
description: A minimal month-view calendar for keeping day-by-day notes.
releaseNotes: Settings now persist through the sidecar in the plugin data directory, so calendar and cell preferences survive reinstalls and upgrades. The cells pane folds into the calendar pane as a cell-style group, adding per-line numbering or bullet prefixes that render in the grid and continue in the editor while the saved note stays untouched.
